title: Sign playtest awards from triage-log decisions, gated on the playtest referee key
body:
Follow-up to epic #9888 (#9884, #9885). The triage log records every acceptance (`openagents playtest log --acceptances`), and NIP-XP's `playtest` rule and `microcoder xp playtest` can sign an award, but nothing turns an acceptance into an award: a person would have to copy fields between two tools.

Scope: an `award` step (for example `openagents playtest award CODE|--issue N`) that joins an acceptance to the tester's public `3197` report (#9904) and the quest, builds the NIP-XP `playtest` award, checks it with the rule, and signs it with the playtest referee key. The production path stays disabled while `PLAYTEST_REFEREE` is `None` (the owner hasn't created the key); tests use a test key.

Acceptance: an award built from a triage-log acceptance passes the `playtest` rule and the ledger; a missing or wrong referee key refuses; a dry run prints the award; no secret is printed; docs updated.
